class.name: GameplayConnectionView
class.brief_description: Server-owned view used to evaluate relevancy for one admitted connection.
class.description: Carries the authoritative position, team, and per-pass scheduling budget for a connection. [GameplayMultiplayerReplication] accepts views only on a configured server and only for spawned sessions. Incoming client packets never modify this object.

members.member: Maximum sum of configured object update estimates selected during one graph pass. Actual encoded bytes are reported separately because envelope and fragmentation overhead can differ.
Temporary transport peer ID. A replication graph accepts client peer IDs greater than 1.
Authoritative view position used by distance relevancy.
Server-assigned team. Zero means no team and never matches team-only policy.
